create_mocapdataset: create a MocapDataset instance with fps and skeleton parameters for motion capture data
remove_joints_from_dataset: remove specified joints from a MocapDataset and update all subject action positions
get_dataset_subjects: get the list of subjects available in a MocapDataset
get_dataset_fps: get the frame rate of a MocapDataset
get_dataset_cameras: get the camera information from a MocapDataset
